source.raw_prompt: In demo-repo (task T-OBSLIVEA, run run-20261001-obsidianlive-002), loanflow.late_fee_tier.classify_late_fee_tier accepts non-integer day counts: classify_late_fee_tier(10.5) silently returns "standard" and classify_late_fee_tier(True) returns "grace" instead of failing. Make classify_late_fee_tier reject any days_past_due that is not a plain int with ValidationError, and add a regression test in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier.py. Before scoping, consult the team's Obsidian vault for any documented loanflow input-validation convention and follow it if the repository corroborates it.

objective: Add a type check at the top of loanflow.late_fee_tier.classify_late_fee_tier (demo-repo/src/loanflow/late_fee_tier.py:21-28) so that any days_past_due that is not a plain int -- including bool (an int subclass) and float (e.g. 10.5) -- raises loanflow.errors.ValidationError before the existing negative check and threshold comparisons, instead of silently classifying (10.5 -> "standard", True -> "grace"). Follow the repository's established integer-guard idiom `isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, int)` already used at demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py:46 and demo-repo/src/loanflow/primitives.py:24 and :54. This idiom is also documented in the team's Obsidian vault note 'Engineering Notes/loanflow-integer-input-convention.md' (LFCONV-INTGUARD-01, retained read evidence runs/run-20261001-obsidianlive-002/obsidian/read/read-1.json), and the repository corroborates that note. Add a pytest.raises(ValidationError) regression test in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier.py.
out_of_scope: demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier_regression.py (pre-existing disclosed fixture; must not be edited)
Any change to the late-fee tier thresholds or boundaries (grace 0-5, standard 6-29, severe 30+) or to the existing negative-value check in classify_late_fee_tier
demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py, demo-repo/src/loanflow/primitives.py, demo-repo/src/loanflow/errors.py (reference only; already correct; not changed)
Editing the Obsidian vault note itself (read-only historical context)
constraints: Within demo-repo/src/loanflow/late_fee_tier.py, change only the body of classify_late_fee_tier; do not alter the module docstring's existing content beyond what is strictly necessary, and do not restructure the function
Use exactly the repository idiom `isinstance(days_past_due, bool) or not isinstance(days_past_due, int)` (as at demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py:46), placed before the existing negative check
Raise loanflow.errors.ValidationError (already imported in late_fee_tier.py), never TypeError/ValueError

Existing tests in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier.py and demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier_regression.py must keep passing unmodified (new tests may be added to test_late_fee_tier.py; existing ones not weakened)
No new dependency; stdlib isinstance check only
TDD: the failing regression test must be written and run before the production change

acceptance_criteria.description: classify_late_fee_tier(True) and classify_late_fee_tier(False) each raise loanflow.errors.ValidationError (bool rejected even though it is an int subclass).
Existing behavior is unchanged for plain ints: boundaries 0/5 -> grace, 6/29 -> standard, 30/31 -> severe, and classify_late_fee_tier(-1) still raises ValidationError.

demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier.py contains a new pytest.raises(ValidationError) regression test covering the non-int (float and bool) rejection, and both demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier.py and demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier_regression.py pass.

task_graph.description: Confirm with file:line citations classify_late_fee_tier's current body, the ValidationError import, the repository integer-guard idiom at risk_bands.py/primitives.py, that no production caller passes a non-int, and assess the Obsidian note LFCONV-INTGUARD-01 as corroborated/stale/contradicted/context-only.
Write a failing regression test in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier.py first, then add the bool/int type guard to classify_late_fee_tier.
Independently re-run the late-fee tier unit tests (both test files) and confirm each acceptance criterion against real command output; full unit suite as a health check.
